heading.zh-Hant: 出身、學術起步與當選議員
heading.en: Birth, academic start and election to the Chamber

body.zh-Hant: 薩蘭德拉1853年8月13日生於卡皮塔納塔（福賈）的特羅亞。1872年2月29日取得法學學位，1879年2月11日起講授經濟財政立法課程。1886年5月23日的選舉中，他在福賈的複數選區參選，並以選區第三名當選進入眾議院。
body.en: Antonio Salandra was born at Troia in Capitanata (Foggia) on 13 August 1853. He took his law degree on 29 February 1872, and from 11 February 1879 he taught economic and financial legislation. In the election of 23 May 1886 he stood in the multi-member constituency of Foggia and entered the Chamber as the third elected candidate of his constituency.

citations.quote: Nacque a Troia, in Capitanata (Foggia), il 13 agosto 1853
Una volta conseguita – il 29 febbraio 1872 – la laurea in giurisprudenza
gli affidò l’insegnamento di legislazione economico-finanziaria
inaugurato l’11 febbraio 1879
elezioni politiche del 23 maggio 1886, Salandra si candidò
Salandra si candidò nel collegio plurinominale di Foggia
che entrava a Montecitorio come il terzo eletto del proprio collegio

heading.en: Premiership and the declaration of neutrality

body.zh-Hant: 焦利蒂向國王推薦薩蘭德拉接任，內閣於3月21日就任，4月5日眾議院以303票贊成、122票反對、9票棄權表決。1914年8月3日，他在未諮詢焦利蒂與松尼諾的情況下宣布中立。外交部長聖朱利亞諾10月16日去世後，薩蘭德拉兼代外交部，直到11月5日改組，由松尼諾出任外長。次年5月3日，松尼諾決定廢止三國同盟。
body.en: Giolitti named Salandra to the king as his successor; the cabinet took office on 21 March, and on 5 April the Chamber voted 303 in favour, 122 against and 9 abstentions. On 3 August 1914 he declared neutrality without having consulted Giolitti and Sonnino. After Foreign Minister San Giuliano died on 16 October, Salandra took over the Foreign Ministry ad interim until the reshuffle of 5 November, which put Sonnino at the Consulta. On 3 May of the following year Sonnino decided to denounce the Triple Alliance.

citations.quote: Giolitti indicò allora al sovrano Salandra come suo successore
già il 21 marzo l’esecutivo poté insediarsi
Il 5 aprile il voto della Camera fu di 303 voti favorevoli
122 contrari e 9 astenuti
dichiarò la neutralità il 3 agosto, senza aver consultato Giolitti e Sonnino
di San Giuliano tenne un atteggiamento prudente
Alla sua morte – avvenuta il 16 ottobre
Salandra assunse l’interim degli Esteri fino al rimpasto, avvenuto il 5 novembre
con Sonnino alla Consulta e Orlando alla Giustizia
Il 3 maggio Sonnino decise la denuncia della Triplice Alleanza

heading.en: War, decline and the Paris Peace Conference

body.zh-Hant: 薩蘭德拉與松尼諾兩人自行決定了義大利參戰。起初的輿論共識持續到1915年秋，其後開始出現困難：1916年2月他在都靈遭群眾抗議，3月仍拒絕擴大政府、納入急進派。他參加巴黎和會代表團的第一階段，1919年4月之後辭去該職。
body.en: Salandra and Sonnino decided on their own that Italy would enter the war. The initial public consensus lasted until autumn 1915, after which difficulties began: in February 1916 he was heckled by the crowd in Turin, and in March he again refused to widen the government to include the Radicals. He took part in the first phase of the Italian delegation to the Paris Peace Conference and declined the post after April 1919.

citations.quote: Salandra e Sonnino avevano deciso da soli l’ingresso dell’Italia nel conflitto
dopo l’iniziale consenso dell’opinione pubblica, durato fino all’autunno 1915
Salandra era stato contestato dalla piazza a Torino nel febbraio 1916
da ultimo nel marzo 1916 – di allargare la base del governo ai radicali
Conferenza della pace di Parigi, di cui fece parte nella prima fase
declinare l’incarico nella seconda, dopo l’aprile 1919

heading.zh-Hant: 法西斯時期、參議員與去世

body.zh-Hant: 1923年，他已是義大利駐日內瓦國際聯盟的代表，並協助以外交途徑處理科孚島問題。1924年他在法西斯名單中當選，並被任命為預算委員會主席，任至1925年。1925年1月16日，他與里奇奧撤回對法西斯政府的支持。1928年5月20日獲任參議員，1931年12月9日在羅馬去世。
body.en: By 1923 he was Italy's representative at the League of Nations in Geneva, where he helped resolve the Corfu question by diplomatic means. In 1924 he was elected on the Fascist list and named president of the Budget committee until 1925. On 16 January 1925 he, together with Vincenzo Riccio, withdrew his support from the Fascist government. He was appointed senator on 20 May 1928 and died in Rome on 9 December 1931.

heading.en: Early military career and the Russo-Japanese War

body.zh-Hant: 田中義一的父親是萩藩士。他1892年自陸軍大學校畢業，隨後從軍參加日清戰爭，1898年赴俄國留學，日俄戰爭中任滿洲軍參謀。履歷記載他1905年10月調任參謀本部勤務。
body.en: Tanaka Giichi's father was a retainer of the Hagi domain. He graduated from the Army War College in 1892, served in the Sino-Japanese War, went to Russia to study in 1898 and served as a staff officer of the Manchurian Army in the Russo-Japanese War. His career record lists a posting to the General Staff Office in October 1905.

citations.quote: 父は萩藩士
明治25(1892)年陸軍大学校卒業
日清戦争に従軍
31年ロシア留学
日露戦争では満洲軍参謀として活躍
1905.10参謀本部勤務

heading.zh-Hant: 陸軍省軍務局與參謀次長
heading.en: Army Ministry bureaus and Vice-Chief of the General Staff

body.zh-Hant: 1909年1月，田中出任陸軍省軍務局軍事課長，參與創立在鄉軍人會；1911年6月升任軍務局長，並企圖增設兩個師團。1915年10月任參謀次長，並與西伯利亞出兵有關。
body.en: In January 1909 Tanaka became chief of the Military Affairs Section of the Army Ministry's Military Affairs Bureau and took part in founding the Imperial Military Reserve Association. In June 1911 he became bureau chief and planned the creation of two additional divisions. In October 1915 he became Vice-Chief of the General Staff and was involved in the Siberian Intervention.

citations.quote: 1909.1陸軍省軍務局軍事課長（在郷軍人会の創立に携わる）
1911.6軍務局長
44年軍務局長に昇進、二個師団増設を企図
大正4(1915)年参謀次長となり、シベリア出兵に関与

body.zh-Hant: 1918年9月29日成立的原內閣中，田中義一任陸軍大臣；內閣名簿載明1921年6月9日起陸軍大臣由山梨半造接任。履歷另記他1921年6月晉升大將，1923年9月在第2次山本內閣再任陸軍大臣，該內閣於1923年9月2日成立、1924年1月7日結束，並於1925年4月轉為預備役。
body.en: In the Hara cabinet formed on 29 September 1918 Tanaka Giichi was Army Minister; the cabinet roster shows Yamanashi Hanzo taking over as Army Minister from 9 June 1921. His career record adds that he became a full general in June 1921, was Army Minister again in the second Yamamoto cabinet from September 1923 (the cabinet ran from 2 September 1923 to 7 January 1924), and was placed on the reserve list in April 1925.

heading.en: Seiyukai president and member of the House of Peers

body.zh-Hant: 田中1925年4月起任立憲政友會總裁，並在1926年1月成為貴族院議員；國立國會圖書館的人物解說寫明，他退役後被推為政友會總裁，並由敕選任貴族院議員。
body.en: Tanaka became president of the Rikken Seiyukai in April 1925 and a member of the House of Peers in January 1926; the National Diet Library's portrait entry states that after leaving active service he was made Seiyukai president and a House of Peers member by imperial selection.

heading.en: Prime Minister and Foreign Minister, and death

body.zh-Hant: 田中義一的內閣1927年4月20日成立，任期至1929年7月2日；閣僚名簿列他兼任外務大臣，1928年5月4日起兼內務大臣，同年5月23日由望月圭介接任，1929年6月10日起兼拓務大臣。國立國會圖書館說明他首相任內推動山東出兵，1929年因張作霖爆殺事件責任而總辭，同年9月29日去世。
body.en: Tanaka's cabinet was formed on 20 April 1927 and lasted until 2 July 1929. The cabinet roster lists him as concurrently Foreign Minister, concurrently Home Minister from 4 May 1928 (Mochizuki Keisuke took over on 23 May), and concurrently Minister of Colonial Affairs from 10 June 1929. The National Diet Library notes that as prime minister he promoted the Shandong Expedition, that in 1929 the cabinet resigned over responsibility for the assassination of Zhang Zuolin, and that he died on 29 September 1929.

body.zh-Hant: 段祺瑞（Duan Qirui）生於1865年、卒於1936年。美國國會圖書館的人名權威檔以 Duan, Qirui 為標目，並列有 Tuan, Chʻi-jui 與 Duan, Zhiquan 等異寫；美國外交文件則寫作 Tuan Chi-jui。
body.en: Duan Qirui was born in 1865 and died in 1936. The Library of Congress name authority uses Duan, Qirui as the heading and lists variants such as Tuan, Chʻi-jui and Duan, Zhiquan; the U.S. diplomatic papers spell the name Tuan Chi-jui.

heading.zh-Hant: 1916年出任國務總理兼陸軍總長
heading.en: Premier and Minister of War in 1916

body.zh-Hant: 1916年4月24日美國公使館電報稱，總統頒令改行對國會負責的責任內閣，並任命段祺瑞為國務總理兼陸軍總長。6月30日的電報說，段撤回反對後，總統前夜再度任命他為總理。1917年5月23日他被免去總理職務，隨後多個省份宣布脫離。
body.en: A telegram from the American Legation dated 24 April 1916 reported a presidential mandate establishing a responsible cabinet and appointing Tuan Chi-jui Premier and Minister of War. A telegram of 30 June said that after Tuan withdrew his opposition the President had reappointed him Premier the previous night. On 23 May 1917 he was dismissed as Premier, followed by the secession of several provinces.

citations.quote: American Legation, Peking, April 24, 1916, 6 p.m.

heading.en: Suppressing the 1917 restoration and the November resignation

body.zh-Hant: 1917年張勳復辟時，美國公使館報告說段祺瑞當時只是沒有權力與兵權的平民；但7月2日公使館代表見他，他說已完全掌握軍事形勢。7月11日公使館接獲他的通知，部隊當夜將向張勳軍隊行動；他於7月13日抵達北京。11月16日，段祺瑞與整個內閣辭職，11月17日辭呈撤回。
body.en: During the 1917 monarchist restoration the American Legation reported that Tuan Chi-jui was at that time only a private citizen without authority or command; on 2 July, however, a representative of the Legation saw him and was assured that he already had complete control of the military situation. On 11 July the Legation received notice from him that the troops would move against Chang Hsun's forces during the night, and he arrived in Peking on 13 July. On 16 November Tuan and his whole cabinet resigned, and the resignations were withdrawn on 17 November.

heading.en: Premier in 1918 and the War Participation Bureau

body.zh-Hant: 1918年6月29日的公使館季度報告說，總理段祺瑞主張停止軍事行動會被視為軟弱，會鼓勵南方提出更多要求。同年10月19日的電報則說，軍人集團想把參戰督辦處變成影響政府的中心，而段祺瑞現在是該處首長。
body.en: The legation's quarterly report of 29 June 1918 said that Premier Tuan Chi-jui argued that any cessation of military action would be read as weakness and would encourage the South to make more extravagant demands. A telegram of 19 October 1918 said the military clique wanted to make the War Participation Bureau the centre of their influence on the government and that General Tuan was now at its head.

would be interpreted as weakness

body.zh-Hant: 1924年11月21日電報稱，內閣預定在段祺瑞到北京後，把總理與總統的權力移交給他；11月24日電報說，他當天上午就任「中華民國臨時執政」（Chief Executive）。1926年4月10日電報報導他被軟禁、已辭職的消息，但同一電報也說政變尚未完全成功；4月21日電報稱他在離開前發布命令，並以最後一道命令宣布退休。
body.en: A telegram of 21 November 1924 said the cabinet would hand over the powers of Premier and President to Marshal Tuan once he reached Peking; a telegram of 24 November said that he assumed office that morning as "Chief Executive of the Republic of China". A telegram of 10 April 1926 reported that he had been placed under restraint and had resigned, but also that the coup had not been entirely successful; a telegram of 21 April said that before leaving he issued mandates and in a final mandate announced his retirement from office.
